استقرئن (form X)
# اُسْتُقْرِئْنَ (ustuqriʔna) /us.tuq.riʔ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَقْرَأَ (istaqraʔa)
# اِسْتَقْرِئْنَ (istaqriʔna) /is.taq.riʔ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَقْرَأَ (istaqraʔa)
